Iranian officials assert control over the Strait of Hormuz, say there are no active US talks after President Trump vows to declare the waterway a US territory.

(Arutz Sheva-Israel National News' North American desk is keeping you updated until the start of Shabbat in New York. The time posted automatically on all Israel National News articles, however, is Israeli time.)

flash_691772.description:
Houthi drones target Yemen's Mocha port, killing six. A Saudi Aramco site in Najran is targeted as well.

(Arutz Sheva-Israel National News' North American desk is keeping you updated until the start of Shabbat in New York. The time posted automatically on all Israel National News articles, however, is Israeli time.)

flash_629916.description:
Arutz Sheva-Israel National News is stopping its round-the-clock news updates at this time in honor of the start of Shabbat in North America, where they are being written now.

Updates will resume Saturday night from Israel, following the conclusion of Shabbat at 20:01 Jerusalem time.

Shabbat Shalom!

flash_691775.description:
31-year-old man faces three mischief charges following an egg-throwing vandalism incident during prayers at Saskatoon's Agudas Israel Synagogue.

(Arutz Sheva-Israel National News' North American desk is keeping you updated until the start of Shabbat in New York. The time posted automatically on all Israel National News articles, however, is Israeli time.)

Hezbollah leader Naim Qassem criticizes Lebanese officials for "exposing the army to pressure" by implementing a US-backed framework agreement with Israel.

flash_691776.description: Explosive drone launched towards IDF forces injures three soldiers, prompting attack on Hezbollah battalion commander Ali Samir Al-Haj Hassan.

flash_691779.description: Unseasonable rain swept parts of Israel, with 18.4 mm falling in Maaleh Adumim, flooding in Jerusalem, and key highway temporarily closed amid fears of flash floods.

flash_691778.description: A Bronx man faces hate crime charges after disrupting Shabbat services at Manhattan’s Central Synagogue, injuring a woman and attacking a security guard.

flash_691781.description: Gunfire towards Jewish community and bullet found near synagogue, as Jewish shepherd assaulted and dozens of masked Arabs riot nearby.

flash_691780.description: Former hostage Rom Braslavski makes extraordinary request to National Security Minister Itamar Ben Gvir, who responds by promising to 'move heaven and earth to make that happen.'

flash_691777.description: IDF tank drives over Hamas explosive device near the Yellow Line; terrorists cross Yellow Line, attempting to sabotage IDF weapons.

flash_691783.description: 'Alliance of Brothers' delegation arrives in Colombia, begins working to locate and rescue people trapped under rubble after the recent earthquake.

flash_691782.description: Ra'am chairman MK Mansour Abbas says upcoming elections will be his last, declares, 'The Palestinian state has already been established.'

flash_691787.description: After months of uncertainty, Tehran claims three pilots thought missing since their jets were shot down are alive and being held by Qatari forces.

flash_691786.description: Israeli man, aged 35, found dead in Thailand hotel room.

flash_691784.description: New footage shows the emotional moment Mali and Liel Yahalomi were found in Argentina. 'An entire country was worried about you.'

flash_691790.description: When critics hurl Nazi labels at progressive politicians, they fail to address the actual substance of the threat. Opinion.

flash_691789.description: Iran warns: We will respond to any IDF operation on Ali Al-Taher Ridge

flash_691785.description: A dispute over loud music spiraled into a violent brawl at Holon’s Yamit 2000, leaving two security guards injured and 12 suspects under arrest.

flash_691788.description: New evidence suggests Mali and Liel Yahalomi meticulously planned disappearance, with cash withdrawn, phones wiped, and AI allegedly used to help evade detection.

flash_691792.description: CENTCOM’s Adm. Brad Cooper concludes visit to six Middle East nations, including Israel, and visits the USS Abraham Lincoln, praising troops for their intense deployment.

flash_691791.description: Selichot season opens at the Western Wall Plaza with tens of thousands of worshipers in attendance.

flash_691793.description: Iranian lawmaker mocks Trump over past security logistics while rejecting the US President's statement that Washington will claim the Strait of Hormuz.

flash_691797.description:
The police have opened an investigation into a suspected grenade attack in south Tel Aviv after receiving a report of hearing an explosion near a residential building in the Kiryat Shalom neighborhood.

The police statement stated that damage was caused at the scene and that police and a bomb disposal squad arrived at the scene and began investigating and collecting evidence. The background is believed to be a criminal incident.

flash_691796.description:
A spokesman for the US State Department said in an interview with Al Jazeera that Hezbollah is the main obstacle to Lebanon's economic reconstruction and growth.

According to the spokesman, the terrorist organization "bears sole responsibility for the Israeli presence on the territory of the country." He further emphasized Washington's position regarding the continuation of the necessary steps: "The pilot areas are the only practical path to achieving peace. We expect the Lebanese army to complete the cleanup operations in these areas."

flash_691794.description: Jewish-owned Florida venue cancels a DSA event featuring Rep. Rashida Tlaib over security concerns and values.

flash_691800.description: The IDF carried out strikes overnight Sunday in the Ali Taher Ridge area of Lebanon, while also eliminating terrorist Abu Hassan Alaa, a senior commander in Hezbollah's Badr Unit.

flash_691799.description: Ukrainian drones last night struck the huge logistics complex of the Russian retail giant WildBreeze in the village of Koldino in the Podolsk region, south of Moscow.

flash_691795.description: The immensity of the intra-Muslim carnage dwarfs the regional and global significance of the Arab-Israeli conflict and the Palestinian Arab issue. Op-ed.

flash_691803.description: The 2026 Mattot Arim Parliamentary Achievement Report highlights those Likud MKs who produced more ideological achievements than their colleagues. Op-ed.

flash_691802.description: Jared Kushner once claimed he read 25 books on the Israel-Palestine conflict, defending his role as an ‘expert’ forging the Trump administration's Middle East peace plan. We can relax now. Op-ed.

flash_691798.description:
Iran announced that it has executed Shahram Sadeghi, who was convicted of running over seven police officers during a wave of anti-regime protests. The execution was carried out following a ruling by a court in the city of Karaj.

The Iranian court convicted Sadeqi on serious charges of "operational activity in favor of the Zionist regime, the United States, and hostile groups."

flash_691804.description: A 1,300-year-old complex was discovered near Winter Stadium.

flash_691801.description: Two Israeli research institutions have earned places among the world’s 100 leading universities in the 2026 Shanghai ranking, with Weizmann retaining 71st place and Hebrew University ranking 89th.

flash_691811.description:
Australian Prime Minister Anthony Albanese announced today that the state of New South Wales will launch a program to purchase weapons from citizens.

The program is part of the national response to the Bondi Beach shooting attack last year in which 15 people were murdered at a Hanukkah event.

flash_691810.description: Today, on Tuesday, 3 Elul, a memorial for Rabbi Avraham Yitzhak HaKohen Kook is held at the Mount of Olives in Jerusalem and is broadcast live to the general public.

flash_691808.description: The 35-year-old tourist is suspected of lighting a barbecue at a vacation villa despite an explicit ban.

flash_691806.description: Excerpted from the biography “Above the Stream" by Tzvi Fishman,

flash_691815.description: Coalition chairman Ofir Katz declares that if Likud forms the next government, the judicial reform will return to the Knesset agenda.

flash_691814.description: Minister Itamar Ben-Gvir says four Likud ministers and four MKs approached him about joining Otzma Yehudit in light of its rising poll numbers.

flash_691812.description: Hamas spokesman Hazem Qassem claims that the meetings in Egypt were intended to update the mediators on "Israeli violations" and advance the roadmap.

flash_691809.description: Iranian Foreign Minister Abbas Araghchi said that "60 days have passed since the agreement signed with the US, we have no intention at the moment to return to negotiations with the United States."

flash_691805.description: Chazon Ish: “It appears that what we learned in the Mishnah, that in an obligatory war even a groom goes out from his chamber, does not refer to a situation in which their assistance is needed to win the war, for it is obvious that for the sake of saving lives and saving the nation, everyone is obligated."

flash_691816.description: Students from the Beit El Yeshiva, together with Rosh Yeshiva Rabbi Zalman Baruch Melamed and the yeshiva’s rabbis, gathered to pray at the gravesite of Rabbi Abraham Isaac Kook.

flash_691813.description: The interesting question is not simply how Arday behaved. It is how institutions behaved around him. And how the pattern fits the post October 7th mendacity. Opinion.

flash_691818.description: The Central Bureau of Statistics publishes a preliminary estimate according to which GDP jumped in the second quarter of 2026 by 15.4% on an annualized basis, which is 3.6% compared to the previous quarter. The figure reflects a sharp recovery from the war against Iran, but may still be updated.

flash_691817.description: Two children, ages five and six, were exposed during a family vacation to chocolate containing hallucinogenic mushrooms and hospitalized.

flash_691824.description:
Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu congratulated the Israeli men's marathon team on their historic win of the team gold medal at the European Athletics Championships in Birmingham.

"Our athletes displayed extraordinary determination, dedication, and teamwork, bringing immense honor and a great source of national pride to the State of Israel. Well done!" the Prime Minister proclaimed.

flash_691823.description: Democratic socialism is an oxymoronic trojan horse. Socialism is not and cannot be democratic. Opinion.

flash_691821.description: A haredi politician met with senior rabbis opposed to IDF conscription, as part of talks to establish a new party aimed at restoring the deferment for yeshiva students.

flash_691820.description: Shutting down the economy on Election Day costs the Israeli economy between two and three billion shekels. So why not save billions and vote from home? Prof. Orr Dunkelman explains why the traditional ballot box is still preferable.

flash_691819.description: MK Simcha Rothman tells Arutz Sheva he wants to continue judicial reform, overhaul the attorney general's powers and help shape the next right-wing government.

flash_691831.description: The Trump administration reportedly turned to Kurdistan President Nechirvan Barzani for a secret channel to Iran's IRGC during efforts to end the war.

flash_691830.description: A Mano Geva poll shows broad opposition to approving the ZIM deal amid the involvement of Qatari shareholders: 67.1% oppose the deal, just 2.4% support approve the deal despite involvement.

flash_691828.description: A senior Palestinian Arab source told Al Jazeera that US President Donald Trump’s envoy Jared Kushner is expected to meet with Hamas leaders in Cairo shortly, in the presence of senior Qatari, Egyptian, and Turkish officials. He is then expected to travel to Israel.

flash_691826.description: Police say they still do not know why Mali and Liel Yahalomi disappeared, despite a complex international investigation that found no unusual event.

flash_691822.description: Democratic socialism is an oxymoronic trojan horse. Socialism is not and cannot be democratic. Opinion.

flash_691833.description:
Earlier today (Sunday), the IDF struck an Islamic Jihad terrorist in the Khan Yunis area and a Hamas terrorist in the Nuseirat area in the Gaza Strip.

The terrorists advanced terror attacks and were struck in precise aerial strikes to remove the threat.

Prior to the strikes, steps were taken to mitigate harm to civilians, including the use of precise munitions and aerial surveillance.

flash_691832.description: Defense Ministers Israel Katz and Enrique Rodríguez Burchard signed an agreement expanding security cooperation and strategic ties between Israel and Honduras.

flash_691827.description: i24NEWS Channel correspondent Yonatan Raveh and videographer Nadav Abas were assaulted in Belfast. The cameraman sustained a head injury from a thrown glass.

flash_691825.description: Captured Hamas documents reveal more than a decade of efforts to establish a military infrastructure in Lebanon in coordination with Hezbollah and Iran, including plans for rockets, a 2,000-man fighting force and more.

flash_691836.description: The head of an Interpol unit in the Israel Police describes the search for Mali and Liel Yahalomi: “Initially, we suspected a kidnapping, but it later emerged that it was a planned disappearance."

flash_691835.description: Kozo Okamoto's death brought me back to the moment when General Rehavam Ze’evi placed a pistol on the table - and succeeded in breaking his prisoner’s silence. Op-ed

flash_691829.description: Second time within an hour: IDF strikes terrorist in Gaza

flash_691839.description:
US President Donald Trump’s advisor, Jared Kushner, met with senior Hamas officials in Egypt today and pressed them to begin fulfilling their commitment to disarm.

Read more.

flash_691838.description: Workers renovating a historic Belgian brewery uncovered 49 gold bars and 4,000 ancient coins worth an estimated €9 million-and may now be entitled to a share of the fortune.

flash_691834.description:
Col. (res.) Hezi Nehama, a founder of the Reservist Commanders and Fighters Forum and one of the authors of the “Generals’ Plan" to defeat Hamas, announced that he is joining the Unity Party, led by Gilad Erdan.

Nechama stated: “The Unity Party represents the values I have fought for in recent years through the Reservist Commanders and Fighters Forum, and which I intend to advance from the Knesset in approximately three months."

flash_691842.description: US Ambassador Mike Huckabee visits Rabbi Abraham Isaac HaCohen Kook’s Jerusalem home and opens an exhibit highlighting Chief Rabbis’ historic White House visits.

flash_691841.description: Omer Shem Tov releases a new book recounting his 505 days in Hamas captivity, including 50 days alone, and the faith that helped him endure.

flash_691840.description: Israeli flags at the Rawabi junction were vandalized with paint after months without incident. Binyamin Council head Yisrael Ganz demands a firm IDF response and warns of escalation.

flash_691837.description: Hundreds of residents, family members, and rabbis gathered for a memorial evening in memory of Yehonatan Klimian z"l, who was killed while rappelling in the Keshet Cave in northern Israel.

flash_691846.description:
Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu addressed tomorrow’s Likud primaries, saying he trusts party members to choose their representatives based on their own judgment.

“Tomorrow, I will vote for a winning slate that will ensure that Eisenkot and Yair Golan do not form a narrow government with the Arab parties. I am not interfering in the national slate," Netanyahu said.

flash_691845.description:
The IDF is preparing for the possibility of several days of fighting in Lebanon amid tensions with Hezbollah and military activity in the Ali Taher Ridge and Beaufort Castle areas, according to Channel 12.

According to the report, Israel is determined to destroy terrorist infrastructure in the area, while Hezbollah is attempting to target IDF forces.

flash_691843.description: After meeting Hamas leaders in Egypt, Jared Kushner arrives in Israel to meet Netanyahu. Washington believes PM has agreed in principle to the framework and is demanding its implementation.

flash_691847.description: Dozens of Hezbollah terrorists are believed trapped underground as the IDF strikes senior commanders and prepares for several days of combat after ceasefire violation.

flash_691844.description: Israel Police representative Walter Alejandro Kogan recounts the operation that led him to missing Israelis Mali and Liel Yahalomi in Argentina, a week after they were last seen in Vienna.

flash_691850.description:
Israeli flags displayed at Rawabi Square, near the community of Ateret in the Binyamin region, were vandalized. Officers from the Binyamin police station collected evidence at the scene and launched an investigation to identify those responsible.

Police said they view any damage to Israeli flags and state symbols with utmost seriousness.

flash_691849.description: US President Donald Trump’s envoy Jared Kushner landed in Israel ahead of talks with Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu on Gaza.

flash_691852.description: The body of a 66-year-old Israeli citizen who went missing during a solo cycling trip in Finland last week has been discovered by the roadside.

flash_691851.description: Documents from 2021 reveal backchannel talks and the approved mechanism to transfer millions of dollars through fuel sales.

flash_691848.description: Judea and Samaria police chief Moshe Pinchi says plan to transfer civilian law enforcement powers from IDF to police requires resources, deploying forces, and placing Judea and Samaria Border Police under the district's authority.

flash_691854.description: Citing high expenses and his relationship with North Korean leader Kim Jong Un, President Donald Trump orders Secretary of War Pete Hegseth to scale back drills with South Korea.

flash_691853.description:
A 31-year-old man was seriously injured in a road accident near the Moshe Dayan Interchange.

Magen David Adom paramedics evacuated him to Wolfson Hospital in Holon.

flash_691856.description: Following high-level talks in Egypt with US envoy Jared Kushner, Hamas demands the Board of Peace compel Israel to fulfill its commitments under the Gaza plan.

flash_691855.description:
A man in his 50s was moderately injured in a two-car collision on Highway 4 near Regba Junction.

Magen David Adom EMTs and paramedics provided medical treatment at the scene and evacuated him to the Galilee Medical Center in Nahariya.

flash_691859.description:
South Korea's Ministry of Defense announced that joint military exercises with the United States military "will take place as scheduled."

The announcement comes as a direct response to statements by US President Donald Trump, who announced he had ordered a significant scale-back of joint training due to his relationship with North Korean leader Kim Jong Un.

flash_691858.description: French police launch a criminal probe into a resort cafeteria owner filmed telling a Jewish customer there were "too many Jews" and denying service.

flash_691863.description: Middle East analyst Zvi Yehezkeli harshly criticizes Jared Kushner’s meeting with senior Hamas officials in Egypt: "The very occurrence of this meeting is a victory for Hamas - legitimizing and normalizing the group."

flash_691862.description: Iran's parliament speaker declares victory over the US and Israel, after officials reject Donald Trump's assertion that the US will control the Strait of Hormuz.

flash_691860.description: Ship tracking data shows transit through the Strait of Hormuz nearly stopped over the weekend following attacks on UAE vessels and stalled US-Iran talks.

flash_691857.description:
US President Donald Trump on Sunday praised Saudi Arabia, Turkey and Pakistan for the joint defense agreement they recently signed.

"Very happy to see that Saudi Arabia, Turkey, and Pakistan have recently, and finally, signed the Mecca Joint Defence Agreement. It shows how the Middle East is coming together, and how Countries will finally be able to defend themselves in a more meaningful way. Congratulations to the Great Leadership of the three Nations mentioned. THIS IS A BIG, BOLD, AND IMPORTANT FIRST STEP - WOW!" wrote Trump in a post on Truth Social.

flash_691866.description: Fox News survey places Republican Mike Rogers ahead of anti-Israel Democrat Abdul El-Sayed 51% to 47% in Michigan's Senate contest.

flash_691865.description:
American actress Hayden Panettiere has passed away at the age of 36. Panettiere was widely known for her roles in the hit US television series "Heroes" and "Nashville."

US media outlets reporting her death did not provide details regarding the cause or circumstances of her passing.

flash_691861.description:
A 5.8-magnitude earthquake struck off the coast of Flores Island in Indonesia.

No injuries or damage have been reported so far.

flash_691864.description: Iran's parliament approves a bill penalizing unauthorized interviews with hostile media with up to two years in prison, alongside strict curbs on foreign contact.

flash_691871.description: Jewish watchdog urges NYPD to increase officers in hot spots after synagogue attack.

flash_691870.description:
Police arrested a Jaffa resident in his 20s on suspicion of vandalizing and causing extensive damage at the Church of Saint Anthony in the city.

During the incident, several statues in the church compound were knocked over and broken, while broken crosses were found on the floor and chairs. The suspect was arrested by police and taken to the station for further questioning.

flash_691868.description: According to reports from Gaza, Air Force aircraft carried out targeted strikes this morning against targets and areas in eastern Gaza City.

flash_691874.description: After two soldiers were wounded by FPV drones and the rescue robot was hit, company commander Vladislav Polsky went in without body armor, loaded them into a civilian pickup, and brought them to safety.

flash_691873.description: Extremist elements in Iranian leadership decided to utilize ceasefire period granted by Iran-US memorandum of understanding to prepare for future conflict, Wall Street Journal report reveals.

flash_691869.description:
Lebanese Al Mayadeen TV, which is affiliated with the Hezbollah terrorist organization, reported a strike in the village of Al-Qantara in southern Lebanon overnight.

Artillery strikes were also reported in the area of the village of Al-Mansouri and in the Wadi al-Saluki area in southern Lebanon.

flash_691867.description: German weekly Der Spiegel calls AfD candidate Ulrich Siegmund 'Germany’s most dangerous man,' who could become the far-right party’s first state premier in Saxony-Anhalt, marking a historic turning point in German politics.

flash_691880.description: The Israeli High Court has a long record of flouting the law when it comes to Arab parties’ participation in Knesset elections. But in the post-October 7th era, in which the vulnerability of the state was so vividly exposed, it is essential to vigorously enforce both the spirit and the letter of Clause 7(a) of the Basic Law: The Knesset. Opinion.

flash_691879.description: Col. Yossi Pinto, head of Israeli delegation to Colombia, describes the search for missing people one week after the earthquake, 'We have yet to find any survivors, but Israelis don't give up.'

flash_691877.description: Iran won’t come to the table and Hamas won’t disarm. But as luck would have it Iran, unsuspecting and all, can help Trump gain pole position. Opinion.

flash_691875.description: Residents returning to Givat Tel Talpiot following violent demolition say religious items, credit card, and thousands of shekels missing, and belongings destroyed.

flash_691872.description: Israel needs a doctrine of strategic prevention and overwhelming deterrence. We need to ensure that no potential coalition can ever become sufficiently confident in its ability to overwhelm Israel that it concludes an attack is worth the risk.

flash_691881.description: Over 45,000 Israelis expected to make annual pilgrimage to Uman Ukraine, despite closed Ukrainian airspace, martial law, and a grueling journey across the border.

flash_691878.description: A house can contain people who are different from one another, each with his own character and his own way, and yet they are all living under the same roof. That is the picture we should have of Am Yisrael.

flash_691876.description: Michal and Tal had planned to get married a year from now, but Michal’s mother’s medical condition led them to move up the wedding and hold it at Shaare Zedek Medical Center.

flash_691883.description: Border Police raid Golani live-fire zone after herds repeatedly entered military training areas, forcing IDF exercises to be disrupted or halted. Watch.

flash_691882.description: High Follow-Up Committee delegation visits Temple Mount, Islamic Movement leader shares religious justification for Ra'am's efforts to join center-left government after elections.

flash_691884.description: 14,307 Likud members already exercised their right to vote in Likud primaries. Gotliv claims ballots without her name, Yoni Yosef withdraws candidacy, and Netanyahu expresses support for Osnat Zohar.

flash_691886.description: Seven Jewish tourists from France were attacked by hundreds at the port of Barcelona and subjected to 40 minutes of curses, spitting, and chants against Jews and Israel.

flash_691885.description: Family calls on the public to pray and increase Torah study and good deeds for Rabbi Shalom Pinchas Burstein. 'He is in need of great Heavenly mercy.'

flash_691892.description: US President declines to endorse a candidate in Israel's upcoming elections, but leaves open possibility he could do so later.

flash_691891.description: The power of teshuvah is not limited, it encompasses every domain of life, that of the individual and that of civilization as a whole.

flash_691890.description: The Houthi military spokesman, Yahya Saree, confirmed that the rebel organization attacked a Saudi naval landing ship and four other military boats in the Bab al-Mandeb Strait with ballistic missiles.

flash_691889.description: US President Donald Trump tells Fox News that he will bomb Oman if they 'get in the way,' insists Hamas will disarm.

flash_691888.description: Border Police arrest Qalandiya resident suspected of working to dig tunnel to infiltrate Israel.

flash_691887.description: Three members of Shas' Kiryat Gat slate defect to rival Ahi party, citing Shas' opposition to IDF enlistment for haredim not studying in yeshiva.

flash_691900.description: As government pushes core curriculum, severe teacher shortage prompting haredi leaders to confront deeper problem.

flash_691899.description: Hanan Breuer, who lost his wife Mor shortly after the birth of their son, and Hila Klein, the widow of Elhanan Klein, who was murdered in a terrorist attack, have built a new home together.

flash_691897.description:
A senior Iranian official threatened that Iran has decided to shift its policy from defensive to "completely offensive," Reuters reported.

The official claimed that Iran has set a deadline of several weeks for the US to fully enforce the memorandum of understanding. "All Iranian entities are ready to escalate tensions in the Strait of Hormuz and the region if diplomacy fails. Iran's timetable will be conveyed to the US through intermediary countries. Iran will not wait for the US to continue its naval blockade forever."

flash_691896.description: For the 31st year, one Chicago high school's raffle sends a family to Yerushalayim for Sukkos; drawing September 3rd.

flash_691895.description: UN Rapporteur Albanese said the death toll in Gaza was 680,000 (it’s 70,000 including terrorists), including 380,000 infants under five. When told there were only 341,790 children under five in Gaza to begin with, Albanese said she lied deliberately because “it had the effect I wanted".

flash_691894.description: Transportation Minister Miri Regev claims that the El Al workers’ committee is working against her in the Likud primaries.

flash_691893.description: Directing attention toward bodily sensations reduces inflammation, accelerates recovery in healthy volunteers, new study shows.
